propositions: A 0.11.0 minor release must be cut from reviewed main, requiring version bumps in pyproject.toml, server.json, and uv.lock regeneration, plus CHANGELOG curation.

The release process prescribes incorrect provenance verification: docs/releasing.md directs gh attestation verify (GitHub SLSA predicate) but should use pypi-attestations verify (PyPI PEP 740 publish/v1 predicate).

All 27+ acceptance criteria including version-lockstep guards, CI tests, artifact verification, PyPI publication, GitHub Release tagging, MCP Registry sync, and Homebrew autobump must pass before closure.

A root cause defect in uv.lock (retaining 0.10.1 while pyproject.toml declared 0.11.0) caused Gerrit Verified failure on patchset 1; fixing required explicit lock regeneration to achieve patchset 2 success.
The release workflow must be dispatched from main with required pypi environment approval, and PyPI artifacts verified against the authoritative provenance bundle endpoint.
Release receipts must document all timestamps, commit SHAs, artifact digests, PyPI URLs, GitHub tag/release URLs, MCP Registry confirmation, and Homebrew tap commit before ticket closure.
